Consume.description: Consume food or drink to restore Satiety and Health.

Gather.description: Gather food from resources to add to inventory.

Rest.description: Rest or sleep to restore Stamina.

Work.description: Perform professional, academic, or daily tasks.

Socialize.description: Interact or chat with other people to restore Mood.

Give.description: Give one inventory item to another resident. The detail field should mention what item is being transferred.

Rob.description: Take one inventory item from another resident. The detail field should mention what item is being taken if possible.

Recreate.description: Leisure, games, or music to improve Mood.
